title: Conditions
immune: The character is immune to it, so it has no effect.
death: {{name}} at this level is death. It gives no number.
givenBy: Given by {{names}}. End that to end this.
givenByRule: Given by a rule of the game. It ends when its cause does.
otherRuleset: From the {{ruleset}} rules, not this character's rules base. It may not fit.
otherRulesetNotMixing: From the {{ruleset}} rules, and mixing editions is off. It may not fit.
